result.reason: The clause appropriately gives Customer exclusive ownership of Deliverables through an irrevocable assignment and preserves Vendor Technology. However, it does not address Customer Data, as required by the playbook. It also identifies the incorporated Vendor Technology licence only as “perpetual”; without the text of Section 13.2, the operative language does not establish that the licence is irrevocable and royalty-free. Exclusive Customer ownership avoids joint ownership of Deliverables, but no equivalent position is stated for Customer Data. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally structured, although reliance on cross-references leaves key licence protections unconfirmed.
